programme.title: Tin Man: Part 1
programme.desc: This 2 part miniseries is a continuation of the classic story The Wonderful Wizard of Oz. It focuses on the adventures of a small-town waitress named DG who is pulled into a magical realm called the O.Z., ruled by the tyrannical sorceress Azkadellia. Together with her companions Glitch, Raw, and Cain, DG journeys to uncover her lost memories, find her true parents, and foil Azkadellia's plot to trap the O.Z. in eternal darkness.

programme.title: Tin Man: Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing the journey beyond the Yellow Brick Road with the second part of this mini series which re-imagines L. Frank Baum's classic The Wizard of Oz.

programme.title: Cheer for your Life
programme.desc: A high school girl feels defeated during a rough Cheerleader Initiation Week, but her dreams aren’t the only thing at stake when another cheerleader ends up dead.

programme.title: Bonds will be Broken
programme.desc: When her sister Nina is seduced by a mysterious self-improvement cult, Anna decides to go undercover at the cult's annual retreat to save her sister from the sinister cult leader.

programme.title: Goddess
programme.desc: Elspeth Dickens dreams of finding her "voice" despite being stuck in an isolated farmhouse with her twin toddlers. A web-cam becomes her pathway to fame and fortune, but at a price.

programme.title: Down With Love
programme.desc: In 1962 New York City, love blossoms between a playboy journalist and a feminist advice author.

programme.title: The Mambo Kings
programme.desc: Two Cuban brothers bring a new music to 1950s USA. They are as different as the problems that await them.

programme.title: Dangerous Mind of a Hooligan
programme.desc: Five criminals unknown to each other are hired to complete a bank robbery. What should have been a smooth operation soon descends into paranoia, violence and horror.
